body:
The phase-five trial-data success test freezes its synthetic clock at the latest past branch-local noon. This avoids a live-clock failure before 00:03, when the command deliberately refuses to create an earlier session today. All four explicit midnight boundary cases and the production guard remain unchanged.

Only three fixture lines change; no assertion, application clock, data policy or schema changes. Final head fac47698542cf553c069059b553baea7e5c2a1ad contains main 18ab8e772bde6bd31d50410007d832c7863cf150. The test blob is identical to the independently reviewed original; final exact-head parity review is clear.

All five focused PostgreSQL cases passed with 76 assertions at e1675d70c840294685b15c1f092e38f2c490e41a. The subsequent main integration changed only the unrelated Auth fixture; the Trial test blob is unchanged. Scoped Pint and diff checks passed. Fresh CI at the final head is required before merge; previous-head results are not claimed as final-head CI.

Tests use an isolated synthetic database only. No production operation or deployment.
